description: This file declares the DobbyInterface class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, defining methods for managing containers via Dobby, such as starting, stopping, querying, and modifying container states. It includes external dependencies like DobbyProtocol, IDobbyProxy, and IEventHandler.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class managing container lifecycles and states through Dobby proxy, handling container operations and events.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DobbyInterface with an event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the DobbyInterface instance.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Lists all containers, returning their identifiers.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific container by ID.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets current state of a container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified parameters.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a container, optionally forcefully.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: hibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container, possibly with options.

methods.name: wakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes a hibernated container.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command within a container.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to a container.

methods.name: removeAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation from a container.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts a resource into the container.

methods.name: unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a resource from the container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Listener invoked when a container has started.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Listener invoked when a container has stopped.

methods.name: onContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Listener invoked when a container's state changes.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Listener invoked when verification fails.

ctags.name: mEventListenerId
ctags.pattern: /^            int mEventListenerId; \/\/ Dobby event listener ID$/
